request.style: English, male soul voice, deep and resonant, electric piano, upright bass, brushed drums, saxophone, choir pads, mournful and powerful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Arameans saw they had been defeated
They regrouped in the shadow of the field
Hadadezer sent out his messengers
To pull the soldiers from beyond the river
They came to Helam in a heavy line
With Shobach leading them, commander of the fight

[Pre-Chorus]
When David was told of this new threat
He gathered all Israel, strong and set
Crossed the Jordan to meet them face to face
The Arameans drew up their lines in place

[Chorus]
Shobach fell where the battle raged
Struck down by the hand of David's might
He died there in the dust and the blood
The commander of their army, no more stood
The Arameans fled before Israel's power
And the vassal kings bowed to the hour

[Verse]
Seven hundred charioteers were slain
Forty thousand horsemen gone in vain
The resistance broke, the fear was deep
The kings who served Hadadezer had to sleep
They made peace with the people of the land
Subject now to a foreign hand

[Pre-Chorus]
The fear took hold, they dared not stand
To help the Ammonites across the land
The alliance broke, the war was done
Under the rule of the chosen son

[Chorus]
Shobach fell where the battle raged
Struck down by the hand of David's might
He died there in the dust and the blood
The commander of their army, no more stood
The Arameans fled before Israel's power
And the vassal kings bowed to the hour

[Outro]
No longer willing to help the foe
The army of Hadadezer is low
Shobach is gone, the battle is past
Only the truth of this day will last
